title: Vulpes release descriptor (META-INF/vulpes/release.json), format 1
description: Describes one immutable content release. Serialized as UTF-8 with sorted object keys and no insignificant whitespace. packs[].id is unique.

format.description: Format version of release.json. Consumers reject unknown values.

project.description: Project name, equal to the Maven artifactId under net.onelitefeather.vulpes.content.

version.description: SemVer release version; preview builds use <next>-dev.<n>.

revision.description: sha256 over the exact bytes of META-INF/vulpes/snapshot.json.

packs.description: Resource packs of this release, sorted by id. Empty while packs are not built yet.

generator.description: Version of vulpes-generator that built the release.

createdAt.description: Time the release was frozen in the backend (UTC), not the generator's clock.

id.description: Stable variant id, unique within packs; becomes a constant name such as PACK_16X.
